The Company believes these condensed </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:465pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">combined financial statements reflect all adjustments, including normal recurring adjustments, that are necessary for a fair </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:477pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">statement of financial position, results of operations and cash flows for the interim periods shown. 2026</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:502.3pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">. The total </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:309pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">net effect of the settlement of these</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:198.83pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre"> transactions</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:249.04pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre"> is reflected in the condensed combined statements of cash flow in Net </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:321pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">transfer to Parent as a financing activity and in the condensed combined balance sheets as </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:419.42pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">Parent company investmen</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:527.63pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">t. </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:333pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">Certain other historical intercompany transactions between S&amp;P Global and the Company have been classified as related </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:345pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">party, rather than Parent company investment, in the condensed combined financial statements as they were historically </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:357pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">settled in cash.</span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:381pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:82.44pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">The condensed combined financial statements may not be indicative of future performance and do not necessarily </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:393pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">reflect what the condensed combined statements of income, balance sheets and statements of cash flows would have been </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:405pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">had the Company operated as a stand-alone business during the periods presented. Actual costs that would have been </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:417pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">incurred if the Company had operated as a stand-alone company would depend on multiple factors, including </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:429pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">organizational structure and strategic decisions made in various areas, including information technology and infrastructure. </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:441pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">The Company is unable to quantify the amounts that it would have recorded during the historical periods on a stand-alone </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:453pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">basis as it is not practicable to do so. The accompanying condensed combined financial statements and the related notes </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:465pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">should be read in conjunction with the Company&#8217;s audited combined financial statements and related notes included within </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:477pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">the Company&#8217;s Registration Statement on Form 10 filed with the SEC on May 27, 2026, as amended (the &#8220;Registration </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:489pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">Statement&#8221;</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:102.86pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">).</span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:513pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">Fair Value and Financial Instruments</span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:537pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:82.44pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">Certain assets and liabilities are required to be recorded at fair value and classified within a fair value hierarchy based </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:549pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">on inputs used when measuring fair value. The Company&#8217;s other financial instruments, including cash and cash </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:561pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">equivalents, are recorded at cost, which approximated fair value because of the short-term maturity and highly liquid nature </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:573pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">of these instruments.</span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:597pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">Unearned Revenue &amp; Remaining Performance Obligations</span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:621pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:82.44pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">We record unearned revenue when cash payments are received in advance of our performance. The increase in the </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:633pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">unearned revenue balance at </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:174.43pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">June&#160;30, 2026</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:230.25pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre"> compared to </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:284.90999999999997pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">December&#160;31, 2025</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:363.45pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre"> is primarily driven by cash payments received </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:645pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">in advance of satisfying our performance obligations, offset by </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:312.13pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">$60 million</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:358.48pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre"> of revenues recognized that were included in </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:657pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">the unearned revenue balance at the beginning of the period.</span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:681pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:82.44pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">Remaining performance obligations represent the transaction price of contracts for work that has not yet been </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:693pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">performed. As of </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:129.56pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">June&#160;30, 2026</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:185.38pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">, the aggregate amount of the transaction price allocated to remaining performance </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:705pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">obligations was </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:123.44pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">$102 million</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:174.79000000000002pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">. We expect to recognize the majority of revenue on the remaining performance obligations </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:717pt;width:612pt"><span serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">Recently Issued or Adopted Accounting Pronouncements</span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:69pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:76.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">In September of 2025, the Financial Accounting Standards Board (&#8220;FASB&#8221;) issued accounting guidance which </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:81pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">removes references to prescriptive software development stages and includes an updated framework for capitalizing </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:93pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">internal software costs. This guidance is effective for annual reporting periods beginning after December&#160;15, 2027, and </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:105pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">interim reporting periods within those annual reporting periods, and early adoption is permitted. </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:444.48pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">We are currently </span></div><div disclosures</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:333.47pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">.</span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:141pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:76.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">In</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:84.83pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre"> November of 2024, the FASB issued accounting guidance which requires that an entity disclose, in the notes to </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:153pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">financial statements, additional information about specific expense categories. The amendments in this update are effective </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:165pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">for annual reporting periods beginning after December&#160;15, 2026, and interim reporting periods beginning after </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:177pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">December&#160;15, 2027. We are currently evaluating the impact of this guidance on the Company&#8217;s disclosures.</span></div><span></span>
